name: Golf Crest at Godrej City
description: Golf Crest is a residential address within Godrej City, a 145-acre mixed-use township in Panvel, set between the Karnala Bird Sanctuary and the Matheran range. It offers 3 & 4 BHK villa-style residences with large decks, alongside a 9-hole golf course and padel courts in the township.
curation: A 9-hole golf course and padel courts within the township, with township and phase clubhouses
Planned for low density, with larger homes and expansive decks that open to the surrounding hills
Developed by Caroa Properties LLP, in which Godrej Properties is a partner, which is worth noting during due diligence
connectivity: 20 min to Navi Mumbai International Airport
45–60 min to South Mumbai via Atal Setu
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: Aerial view of Godrej City towers among green hills
